newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent rises in range trade, NYMEX steady.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent rises in range trade, NYMEX steady.

text.p: June Brent crude futures firmed on Monday afternoon to climb back above $18.00 per barrel, but brokers said they expected the upside to be limited.

May was last traded at $18.05 per barrel, up 13 cents from the London settlement on Friday of $17.92. Brokers said the London market was not comfortable above $18.00 on Friday which might limit the upside on Monday.
NYMEX crude was offering little support to test the upside potential.
May on ACCESS was last traded at $19.91 per barrel, unchanged from New York, while June was last traded at $19.72, up five cents.
In the absence of fresh news, brokers said they expected further sideways action from the market with June locked between a chart gap on the upside of $18.40 and a low of $17.50.
